problems.location: p.3496(PDF22),switching sequence condition(1),(2);p.3497(PDF23),first paragraph and Fact6.3(1),(2)
problems.claim: a_n realizing J_n satisfies Fact6.3(1), including psi(a_n,d_n).
problems.decisive_evidence: J_n uses b_n^1, giving rho(a_n,b_n^1); condition(2) includes i=j and forbids rho(x,b_n^1) with rho(x,b_n^2). Thus psi(a_n,d_n) is false, contrary to required diagonal. Exact finite index calculation confirms all20diagonal failures.
problems.all_hypotheses: Uses exactly the constructed switching convention and its stated pairwise inconsistency for i<=j. This is a local application-index check, not a countermodel to Theorem1.6.
problems.impact: Printed terminal application has incorrect endpoint; no substantive theorem failure.
problems.repair: Choose a_n along J_(n+1); change undefined b_i,b_j in Fact6.3(2) to d_i,d_j. Direct relation R=((phi(x,y') and psi(x',y) and not exists z(phi(z,y) and psi(z,y')))) has no3-cycles and an infinite chain, even from the original strict off-diagonal pattern.
problems.counterevidence: Uniform shift supplies exactly all required conditions; independent direct3-cycle argument avoids reliance on inaccessible corrected external proof.

independent_acceptance.performing_role: Primary assistant in the assigned acceptance Chat; independent of original initial-review conversation
independent_acceptance.source_claim_and_location: PDF21/printed3495 selects rho with two-inconsistency. PDF22/printed3496 defines J_n using b_i^2 for i<n and b_i^1 for i>=n, and condition (2) includes i=j. PDF23/printed3497 chooses a_n along J_n but requires psi(a_i,d_i) in Fact 6.3(1).
independent_acceptance.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: The original switching convention, coheir realization, pair type equivalence for i<=j and the same two-inconsistent rho are retained. The check is conditional on the already constructed array and does not assume simplicity or prove a countermodel to the main theorem.
independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: For the printed a_i, rho(a_i,b_i^1) holds. The same-index instance of condition (2), combined with the selected two-inconsistent formula, excludes rho(a_i,b_i^2), so the diagonal psi required in Fact 6.3 is false. Replacing J_n by J_(n+1) gives phi for i<j and psi for i>=j exactly.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_boundaries: The strict off-diagonal pattern already yields an infinite chain for R((x,y),(x',y'))=phi(x,y') and psi(x',y) and not-exists-z(phi(z,y) and psi(z,y')). In a directed triangle, edge1 supplies phi(x1,y2), edge3 supplies psi(x1,y3), and edge2 forbids their joint realization. Thus the original pattern itself supplies SOP3 without relying on the inaccessible corrected external proof.
independent_acceptance.severity_result: Minor retained. The printed witness does not satisfy its cited fact, but both a uniform index shift and a direct finite-formula three-cycle argument preserve the terminal contradiction without an added hypothesis. No core theorem failure is demonstrated.
independent_acceptance.repair_check: The J_(n+1) shift and replacement of undeclared b_i,b_j by d_i,d_j in Fact6.3(2) are locally sufficient. The direct R argument was independently reconstructed for all i<j; retained finite index and Boolean outputs are corroboration, not a proof of the entire first-order argument.

independent_acceptance_scope.summary: Independent focused check of the terminal switching-sequence application and the repair of P1, using publisher PDF pages 21-23. The earlier canonical-coheir and tree arguments are retained as initial-review coverage and were not reviewed again.
